# Biolex

> Biolex is a free printables library for the home. We design, print-test,
> and give away original wall art, coloring pages, home organization printables,
> kids and preschool worksheets, and meal planning templates, each paired with a
> short how-to guide on printing, framing, and using it. Every file is free, needs
> no sign-up, and prints clean on a standard home printer (US Letter, 8.5" x 11").

Niche: Free printables for the home
Domain: www.biolexlife.com

## Start Here

New here? Browse the [Free Printables](/free-printables) library or read the
[Blog](/blog) for printing, framing, and how-to guides. The full story is on the
[About](/about) page.
